verse.unicode: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਸਭੈ ਮਤ ਸੁਨਿ ਕੈ ਕਰੀ ਕਰਮ ਕੀ ਆਸਾ ॥

transliteration.english: bedh puraan sabhai mat sun kai karee karam kee aasaa ||

en.bdb: Listening to all the teachings of the Vedas and the Puraanas, I wanted to perform the religious rituals.

verse.unicode: ਕਾਲ ਗ੍ਰਸਤ ਸਭ ਲੋਗ ਸਿਆਨੇ ਉਠਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪੈ ਚਲੇ ਨਿਰਾਸਾ ॥੧॥

transliteration.english: kaal grasat sabh log siaane uTh pa(n)ddit pai chale niraasaa ||1||

en.bdb: But seeing all the wise men caught by Death, I arose and left the Pandits; now I am free of this desire. ||1||

verse.unicode: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਸਰਿਓ ਨ ਏਕੈ ਕਾਜਾ ॥

transliteration.english: man re sario na ekai kaajaa ||

en.bdb: O mind, you have not completed the only task you were given;
you have not meditated on the Lord, your King. ||1||Pause||

verse.unicode: ਬਨ ਖੰਡ ਜਾਇ ਜੋਗੁ ਤਪੁ ਕੀਨੋ ਕੰਦ ਮੂਲੁ ਚੁਨਿ ਖਾਇਆ ॥

transliteration.english: ban kha(n)dd jai jog tap keeno ka(n)dh mool chun khaiaa ||

en.bdb: Going to the forests, they practice Yoga and deep, austere meditation; they live on roots and the fruits they gather.

verse.unicode: ਨਾਦੀ ਬੇਦੀ ਸਬਦੀ ਮੋਨੀ ਜਮ ਕੇ ਪਟੈ ਲਿਖਾਇਆ ॥੨॥

transliteration.english: naadhee bedhee sabadhee monee jam ke paTai likhaiaa ||2||

en.bdb: The musicians, the Vedic scholars, the chanters of one word and the men of silence, all are listed on the Register of Death. ||2||

verse.unicode: ਭਗਤਿ ਨਾਰਦੀ ਰਿਦੈ ਨ ਆਈ ਕਾਛਿ ਕੂਛਿ ਤਨੁ ਦੀਨਾ ॥

transliteration.english: bhagat naaradhee ridhai na aaiee kaachh koochh tan dheenaa ||

en.bdb: Loving devotional worship does not enter into your heart; pampering and adorning your body, you must still give it up.

verse.unicode: ਰਾਗ ਰਾਗਨੀ ਡਿੰਭ ਹੋਇ ਬੈਠਾ ਉਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਹਿ ਕਿਆ ਲੀਨਾ ॥੩॥

transliteration.english: raag raaganee ddi(n)bh hoi baiThaa un har peh kiaa leenaa ||3||

en.bdb: You sit and play music, but you are still a hypocrite; what do you expect to receive from the Lord? ||3||

verse.unicode: ਪਰਿਓ ਕਾਲੁ ਸਭੈ ਜਗ ਊਪਰ ਮਾਹਿ ਲਿਖੇ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ॥

transliteration.english: pario kaal sabhai jag uoopar maeh likhe bhram giaanee ||

en.bdb: Death has fallen on the whole world; the doubting religious scholars are also listed on the Register of Death.

verse.unicode: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਜਨ ਭਏ ਖਾਲਸੇ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਜਿਹ ਜਾਨੀ ॥੪॥੩॥

transliteration.english: kahu kabeer jan bhe khaalase prem bhagat jeh jaanee ||4||3||

en.bdb: Says Kabeer, those humble people become pure - they become Khalsa - who know the Lord's loving devotional worship. ||4||3||
